items.item: User can speak a request and reach the same gates as typing
User is never recorded unless they armed the session
User can hear a spoken result for a voice turn
Stage gate: speech required no new approval gates

bugs.title: Pending email draft swallows every later spoken or typed request and persists across pages
bugs.repro: Say 'send an email to someone at example.com', then say gibberish / 'what model are you' / type 'tidy this folder'

bugs.title: Reply (and spoken text) says nothing was prepared for approval while an approval card is on screen
bugs.repro: Create tidy card by typing, then say 'yes approve it, go ahead, I approve'

bugs.title: Spoken requests barely audited: anonymous voice.heard rows only, no gateway.turn for them

undesired.title: Same utterance answered repeatedly with a looping source, no de-duplication
Silence/noise/tone only yield repeated Hello nudges, no 'only noise heard' message
Long ~25 s ramble produced no Heard note or result within 40 s
No hint that speech cannot approve and the button must be pressed
Known: greeting turns clutter chat; voice.armed rows flood audit (17 armed vs 4 disarmed)
